content.comment_body: I have a unique project where I need a [product_name] device to generate an output voltage ranging from 0 to 10V. The output should be updated when a digital input is pulsed—the device then reads an analog input value (within 0 to 10V), stores that value, and sets the output to match. The output should remain unchanged until the next digital input pulse, at which point the process repeats with the new analog input value. I would greatly appreciate any ideas or solutions from the engineering community.

Hello, Your solution aligns with approaches found in [company_name] support documentation [url], specifically regarding filtering analog values. This is also a compact and effective setup. Additionally, this method allows for the use of retentive memory. Other techniques for storing values include: - Flow totalization - Calculating mean temperature with two sensors - Analog filters (such as Bessel or Butterworth) Best regards [user_name]
